native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'initial', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. Both LEDs are off after power-on or reset.'}

test2: {'time': 'after pressing btn1 and waiting 2 seconds', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn1, LED1 toggles from off to on. LED2 remains off. State is stable for 2 seconds.'}

test3: {'time': 'after pressing btn2 and waiting 2 seconds', 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'on'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn2, LED2 toggles from off to on. LED1 remains on. State is stable for 2 seconds.'}

test4: {'time': 'after pressing btn1 again and waiting 2 seconds', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'on'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn1 again, LED1 toggles from on to off. LED2 remains on. State is stable for 2 seconds.'}

test5: {'time': 'after pressing btn3 and waiting 2 seconds', 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn3, both LEDs are reset to off regardless of their previous states. State is stable for 2 seconds.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
